status: analyst probe recipes only; not rendered reference evidence

SIG-MULTI.definition: Both channels identical sum of sine tones 100, 1000 and 6000 Hz, each peak amplitude 0.1; initial phase 0.

SIG-STEREO.definition: Left sine 440 Hz peak 0.25, right sine 3000 Hz peak 0.125; initial phase 0.

SIG-440.definition: Both channels sine 440 Hz peak 0.25; phase 0.

SIG-PULSE.definition: Both channels sine 1000 Hz peak 0.25 gated on for first 100 ms of each second, otherwise zero; no edge ramp.

modulation_fixture_status: Proposed setups and required future observations only; none executed. Requested values are not proved control domains/defaults. An unavailable setting or missing baseline yields U, never pass.

AF-AUDIO.input: SIG-MULTI unless the case replaces it with a named nonzero stimulus; source routed to the tested device and source/device/track enabled and unmuted.

requested_controls.Output: accepted nonmuting setting; request displayed 0 dB only if that unit is offered

AF-AUDIO.preflight: Confirm every requested control value is accepted; record exact accepted labels/values, source routing, source amplitude and output meter/spectrum baseline. Confirm nonzero filtered output and a manual Freq move changes output timbre/spectrum; restore 1000 Hz. If unavailable, clamped or indeterminate, mark probe U and stop its signal comparison.
AF-AUDIO.override_rule: Case-specific filter/stimulus/control changes replace only named settings. Keep all other controls fixed and re-establish nonzero output/response after an override. Never infer neutral whole-device transfer.

AF-LFO.input: SIG-MULTI, continuous stereo stream; Set tempo 120 BPM; transport running; record transport position/clock origin without asserting a reset law.

requested_controls.LFO Amt: request +50% and require accepted nonzero setting; record exact displayed units/value
requested_controls.LFO quantization: inactive accepted chooser state, record label

AF-LFO.active_baseline: With Envelope=0, compare LFO Amt=0 with the accepted nonzero tested Amt, holding all other controls fixed. Independently observe repeating movement of the displayed filter curves AND changing output-spectrum shape/audible timbre, not just an LFO indicator. Keep accepted Amt nonzero thereafter; record response and unclamped cutoff excursion. Absent/inaudible/indeterminate response is U and cannot pass a no-effect case.
AF-LFO.mode_preflight: After each Wave/time/quantization/stereo-mode change, record the accepted setting and reconfirm observable modulation with the tested LFO still active and Envelope=0. Numeric waveform, phase alignment, seed and audio thresholds remain U.

AF-ENV.input: SIG-PULSE (1000 Hz, peak 0.25, 100 ms on each second); continuous loop/stream at Set tempo 120 BPM; internal detector unless case names external source.

requested_controls.Envelope: request +50% and require accepted nonzero setting; record displayed units/value
requested_controls.Attack: request 250 ms if unit offered; otherwise record accepted attack value and demonstrate attack outlasts 100 ms pulse for Hold case
requested_controls.Release: request 500 ms if unit offered, record accepted displayed units/value

AF-ENV.active_baseline: With LFO Amt=0, compare Envelope=0 with accepted nonzero Envelope under repeated pulses. Independently observe envelope-driven filter-curve movement AND corresponding changing output-spectrum shape/audible timbre, not merely an envelope indicator. Restore tested Envelope nonzero and keep nonmuted fully wet output. If unavailable, clamped or response absent/indeterminate, mark U and do not grade any no-effect comparison.
AF-ENV.mode_preflight: Record accepted numeric Attack/Release values and same stimulus/routing for comparison pairs. Reconfirm detectable envelope response after source/SC-filter/quantization changes. Exact detector threshold, units conversion, curves and timing tolerances remain U.
